newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says ODA loans utilisation up.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says ODA loans utilisation up.

text.p: The Philippines said on Thursday disbursement of official development assistance (ODA) has improved in the past ten months.

"ODA disbursements for the period January to October 1996 went up by 7.9 percent, compared to last year's figures. Cumulative loan disbursements reached $1.18 billion, up from the $1.09 billion disbursed in the same period last year," the Coordinating Council of the Philippine Assistance Programme (CCPAP) said in a statement.
The usage of ODA has been an issue with some donor countries which complained that loans given to Philippine projects were not immediately disbursed.

"Over the last three years, we have shown considerable improvement in utilising ODA. While I am confident that our absorptive capacity is no longer an issue with the donor community, I hope our performance in this will translate into increased support for our development programmes and projects," CCPAP Roberto de Ocampo said in a statement released in Manila.
The Philippines is once again seeking assistance from bilateral and multilateral financing institutions to help finance big-ticket infrastructure projects.
De Ocampo earlier said he hoped to bring in $2.5 billion in new loans.
